title: Computer fundamentals first-path verification
summary: Preserve the existing introduction and add files, networks, protection, algorithm testing and an integrated capstone using the current lesson player and progress backend.

changes.detail: Five substantive English lessons with worked examples, diagrams, independent tasks, explained quizzes, evidence rubrics and a capstone; original Arabic introduction retained.
New lesson completion requires saved exercise evidence and rubric self-review as well as quiz success. Existing progress is preserved and self-review is not presented as certified mastery.
Course briefs show audience, requirements, outcomes, workload, progression, targeted revision and next courses.

validation.name: Content and progress models
validation.detail: 15 tests passed for curriculum structure, exact navigation, executable boundary example, rubric persistence, preserved records and roadmap/project rules.

validation.name: Interaction gate before expansion
validation.detail: 10 focused tests passed: rubric rating, revision links, remount persistence, next-course navigation, lesson completion, restart and course workshops. TypeScript passed after correcting a tuple-spread type error.

validation.name: Limits
validation.detail: No native-device or live cloud checks, no deployment. Self-review is not an independent assessment; new lessons are English and the original introduction remains Arabic.
